// diagnostic

E0162

`` `++`/`--` is not defined for {type} ``.

What

`` `++`/`--` is not defined for {type} ``.

Why

Increment and decrement work on integer types only (D-INCR1).

Fix

On `Float`, use `+= 1.0` / `-= 1.0`; otherwise use `+= 1` / `-= 1` on an integer binding.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0162: tests/ui/incr_float.stderr.

Error [E0162]: `++`/`--` is not defined for Decimal (an exact base-10 number)
  --> tests/ui/incr_float.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     f++
    |     ^^^
 Why: increment and decrement work on integer types only
 Fix: use `f += 1` / `f -= 1` on an integer binding
